title: Wellness Membership Rules of Use: Sessions, Screens, Classes and Guest Passes
content:
The services included in a Wellness Membership are used within the limits of its tier, and only in two statuses of the membership.

## When services may be used

Sessions, screens, analyses, classes and guest passes are used only while the membership is active or pending cancellation. The status that decides it is the status of that membership in the company's records.

| Status of the membership | Sessions, screens, analyses, classes and guest passes used |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes |
| Pending cancellation | Yes |
| Pending start | No |
| Frozen | No |
| Past due | No |
| Cancelled | No |

## Open gym and open swim

Open-gym visits are allowed only where the tier includes the gym, and open-swim visits only where the tier includes the pool. Neither an open-gym visit nor an open-swim visit draws a session.

## Maintenance sessions

A maintenance session lasts the session length of the tier, draws one credited session, and is booked no more than the tier's booking horizon ahead.

## Annual and per-period limits

| Service | Limit | Counting window | What is counted |
|---|---|---|---|
| Movement screens | the tier's screens per year | the current calendar year, January 1 to December 31, by appointment date | movement screens attended on this membership |
| Performance analyses | the tier's analyses per year | the current calendar year, January 1 to December 31, by appointment date | performance analyses attended on this membership |
| Group classes | the tier's classes per billing period | the billing period containing the class date | group classes attended on this membership |
| Guest passes | the tier's guest visits per billing period | the billing period containing the guest visit | guest visits recorded on this membership |

## Missed sessions

A no-show forfeits the session where the tier's terms forfeit a session for a no-show, and a cancellation with less than the tier's late-cancellation notice forfeits it where the tier's terms forfeit a late-cancelled session. No fee is ever charged for a missed membership session.

## Expiry of unused sessions

At the end of each billing period, unused sessions above the tier's rollover limit expire. On cancellation, all unused sessions expire.

### Worked example (hypothetical)

A member on a tier whose rollover limit is 2 ends a billing period with 3 unused sessions: 1 session expires and 2 are carried into the next billing period. Had the member ended the period with 2 unused sessions, none would expire. If the membership is later cancelled with 2 unused sessions, both expire.
